drag_to_rearrange_the_cards_or_focus_thi: Drag to rearrange the cards — or focus this handle and use ← →
nothing_uploaded_on_this_case_yet: Nothing uploaded on this case yet.
everything_the_switch_is_filed_against_a: Everything the switch is filed against, and every field of it is corrected in one modal — the supply point read off the bill and the customer's own record included, saved back to the bill and the account behind the scenes. Only the offer's tariff terms are read-only: they belong to the offer, and editing a copy of them here would let the two drift apart. Drag a card by its handle to put it where you want it — the arrangement is remembered on this browser.
pdf_jpg_png_webp_select_multiple_files: PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP — select multiple files
the_customer_is_signing_with_the_supplie: The customer is signing with the supplier. Nothing happens in the app until the supplier confirms — then move the case to In Activation with the two dates they gave you.
the_customer_already_sees_this_utility_i: The customer already sees this utility in My Utilities, with the activation date above. Mark it activated once the supply is live.
the_utility_has_been_activated_the_custo: The utility has been activated. The customer can see it in their My Utilities section.

this_case_receives_digital_invoices_so_n: This case receives digital invoices, so no shipping address is used. Anything entered here is stored but not shown on the case.

you_can_cancel_this_deletion_at_any_time: You can cancel this deletion at any time
shown_to_users_as_contract_sign_guidelin: Shown to users as "Contract Sign Guideline" on contracts from this supplier.
offer_order_reloaded: The customer still sees the previous order — the list has been reloaded.
status_moved_back_notified: Status moved back to "{{status}}" — the customer has been notified.
status_updated_notified: Status updated to "{{status}}" — the customer has been notified.
registered_office_help: The company's sede legale, as the contract is headed.
save_blocked: Can't save: fix the highlighted field ({{error}}).
save_failed_unexpected: Saving failed because of an unexpected error. Please try again.
offer_fields_locked: Offer accepted by users — fields locked
confirm_action: Are you sure you want to {{action}}?
public_page_missing: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.
public_tagline: The Italian platform for energy supplier comparison and switching.
document_rejected: Document rejected. The customer has been notified.
waiting_for_replacement: Waiting for the customer to upload a new document
reject_document_title: Reject the document and request a new one
reject_document_help: "{{name}}" will be marked as not acceptable and the customer will be notified to upload a new one. The new document comes back for review.
rejection_note_placeholder: E.g. the back of the ID card is missing
rejection_customer_notified: The customer sees the reason and the note in the notification and on their request.
edit_case_section_case_hint: How the case is classified, queued and staffed. The pipeline status is changed from the case header.
edit_case_section_customer_hint: The account the switch is submitted under. These fields belong to the customer's record, so a correction here follows them onto every other case they have.
edit_case_section_supply_bill_hint: Read off the uploaded bill, and what the switch is filed against — the POD or PDR here is the number sent to the new supplier. Corrections made here are the same ones the Bill Data tab makes.
edit_case_section_offer_hint: The offer the switch is filed against. Changing it moves the destination supplier with it.
edit_case_section_payment_hint: How the customer pays the new supplier. The offer may only accept one method.
edit_case_section_invoicing_hint: Where the supplier sends the invoices.
edit_case_section_supply_address_hint: Where the energy is delivered, as the switch is filed. The address printed on the bill is edited above; this is the one the new supplier is given.
edit_case_section_contract_dates_hint: Contract signing happens outside the app, so every date here is entered by hand. Both activation dates are required before a case can be put in activation, and the supply must expire after it goes live.
edit_case_section_commercial_sla_hint: What the switch is booked at and how long it is allowed to take. Nothing derives these — they are the figures the board and the commission reconciliation report against.
edit_case_section_notes_hint: The first is shown to the customer on their case; the second never leaves the CRM.
